requirements.text: A patient logs in with a mobile number and a one-time code sent by SMS. The code expires after 5 minutes.
The patient can search doctors by specialty and by clinic. Results show name, specialty, clinic and the next free slot.
The patient picks a free slot and confirms. The system books it and shows a booking number in the format SC-YYYY-NNNNN.
A patient may hold at most 3 future bookings at the same time.
The patient sees all future bookings sorted by date, nearest first.
The patient can cancel a booking up to 24 hours before the appointment. After that, the cancel button is hidden.
The system sends an SMS confirmation right after booking and a reminder SMS 24 hours before the appointment.
Clinic staff set each doctor's weekly working hours. Slots are 20 minutes long.
Staff can block a slot (e.g. doctor on leave). Blocked slots do not appear to patients.
A daily report lists bookings per clinic and per doctor, exportable to Excel.
All patient screens are available in Arabic (default) and English.

known_issues.title: Booking number shows the wrong year on bookings made on 31 December
